verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships as an installable ISO: you write it to a USB stick, answer five questions, and get a finished desktop. Community users confirm the install is quick and uncomplicated, and full-disk encryption is mandatory, which points to a whole-disk install on the machine. One user's ISO install failed on a low-end Chromebook, but that is a single hardware edge case, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of wiping and replacing an existing OS (the docs cite dual-boot beside Windows rather than replacement), and guidance on migrating data from the prior OS.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can install the OS in place of my current OS on the same machine

citations.quote: Write the ISO to a USB stick and answer five questions. It hands back a finished desktop.
the install is uncomplicated with no bootloader or WM choices
installation is fairly quick (~5 minutes on a fresh machine) given decent bandwidth
